title: Partition of Unity Neural Networks for Interpretable Classification with Explicit Class Regions
abstract: arXiv:2602.00511v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce \emph{Partition of Unity Neural Networks} (PUNNs), a neural-network architecture for multiclass classification based on the classical mathematical notion of a partition of unity. The starting point is the observation that the characteristic functions of ideal class regions form a partition of unity. PUNNs replace these discontinuous indicators by learned continuous functions \[ h_1,\ldots,h_C:\mathcal X\to[0,1] \] whose sum is identically one and whose values are interpreted directly as class probabilities.   The partition functions are generated through a recursive family of input-dependent gates. This construction guarantees nonnegative class probabilities summing to one without a separate normalization layer such as softmax, while providing an explicit ordered factorization of each probability in terms of the gate values. translated_title: 单位分解神经网络：具有明确类别区域的可解释分类方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.00511v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们引入了\emph{单位分解神经网络}（PUNNs），这是一种基于经典数学概念“单位分解”的多类分类神经网络架构。其出发点在于，理想类别区域的特征函数构成一个单位分解。PUNNs将这些不连续的指示函数替换为学习到的连续函数 \[ h_1,\ldots,h_C:\mathcal X\to[0,1] \]，这些函数的和恒等于一，其值直接解释为类别概率。这些分解函数通过递归的输入相关门控族生成。该构造保证了非负的类别概率之和为一，无需像softmax这样的独立归一化层，同时提供了每个概率基于门控值的显式有序分解。由此产生的门控轨迹为每个类别概率如何形成提供了可解释的表示。
tldr: 本文提出单位分解神经网络（PUNNs），通过递归门控生成连续且和为1的类别概率，无需softmax，并提供显式可解释的门控轨迹，实现具有明确类别区域的分类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Partition of Unity Neural Networks (PUNNs), which generate continuous class probabilities summing to one via recursive gates without softmax, offering an interpretable gate trace for explicit class regions.
